# Kentaro Vadney's sites

> Free sites and tools by Kentaro Vadney (バドニー賢太郎), a software engineer. Each site below has its own llms.txt with more detail. None of them has tracking, ads or a sign-up.

## About him

- [Projects and work](https://vadneyk.github.io/portfolio/): his projects page, in English
- [作品と経歴](https://vadneyk.github.io/portfolio/ja/): the same page in Japanese

## Sites

- [How to Find Internships](https://vadneyk.github.io/internships/): a free guide for teens ages 12 to 18 in the US and Vancouver, BC, with real programs, work-permit rules and a message to send; open data under CC BY 4.0
- [Student Job Kit](https://vadneyk.github.io/student-job-toolkit/): a free job-search kit for college students and new grads that works with a free AI chat account
- [chapter-and-verse](https://vadneyk.github.io/chapter-and-verse/): a sample report from a tool that checks every scripture claim in an AI-written study plan against the Bible text
- [Open Word Study](https://vadneyk.github.io/open-word-study-site/): shows how a Greek or Hebrew word is translated in every place it appears, built from open data
- [The Way](https://vadneyk.github.io/the-way/): an open-source pixel art RPG that follows the disciples through the Gospels

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/VadneyK): his public repositories
